subject: Request: hosted API volume pricing — Mediq pilot (discount ask)
messages:
From: Sienna Park <sienna.park@mediq.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pilot pricing — urgent ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with latency and the monitoring features. We want to run a 6-month pilot across 3 product lines and estimate ~1.2B tokens/month at peak. Our procurement needs a commercial that hits our internal cost thresholds to get leadership signoff.

Straight to the point: can Redwood accommodate a 30% discount off published Hosted API usage rates for a 12-month commitment (pilot + option to extend)? We understand this is a sizeable concession; we can provide an LOI + immediate purchase order for the pilot to compress procurement timelines.

Attaching the RFP and our expected usage profile. Procurement is standing by for an approved commercial so we can move to legal.

Thanks,
Sienna Park
Head of Product Partnerships — Mediq Health
[Attachment: Mediq_RFP_20260915.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sienna Park <sienna.park@mediq.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pilot pricing — urgent ask

Hi Sienna — appreciate the clarity and the rapid timeline.

Short answer: we don't typically do 30% off list for Hosted API out of the gate. That said, I think there is room for a commercial concession given the scale and strategic nature of Mediq. I am looping in Ben (SR Sales Lead) and Marissa (Sales Ops) to get a quick read on economics and to escalate for senior approval.

Proposed next steps:
- Ben/Marissa to confirm max feasible discount and any required contract conditions (commit term, usage SLAs, billing cadence).
- If we exceed 20% discount, we will need senior exec signoff and a formal memo to legal with redlines.
- If Mediq can provide a PO/LOI this week, we can prioritize the deal desk review.

I'll keep you posted — aim to have an answer by tomorrow EOD PT.

Best,
Karthik Iyer | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (555) 732-1189
[Inline: quoted RFP acknowledged]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 07:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pilot pricing — urgent ask

Karthik/Ben — I ran a preliminary margin and ARR-sensitivity analysis on the Mediq profile (attached pricing_model_v3.xlsx). Key takeaways:

- At published Hosted API list rates and the projected token volumes, incremental margin is healthy after our infra/ops allocation.
- A 25% concession across their requested volume for a 12-month committed term still keeps us within allowable deal desk thresholds for strategic plays, assuming upfront PO and a defined review at month 6.
- A straight 30% concession would push the unit economics below our standard threshold unless we convert to a multi-year commit or take a significantly higher minimum monthly guarantee.

Recommendation: approve a one-time authorized concession of 25% off list for a 12-month commitment with these conditions:
1) Mediq issues PO for the pilot within 5 business days.
2) Contract includes a 6-month commercial review with usage telemetry shared to Redwood.
3) Legal to accept our standard Hosted API Addendum with the redlined clause limiting usage-export guarantees (see redwood_tnc_redline.docx).

Because this is >20%, please Marcus (cc'd) — can you confirm senior sign-off? If approved I will prepare a short approval memo for Legal + Finance and draft the commercial term sheet.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole | Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing_model_v3.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pilot pricing — urgent ask

All — after reviewing Marissa's model and the strategic upside with Mediq, I approve a 25% discount off Hosted API list rates for a 12-month committed pilot under the conditions she laid out.

Operational/contract instructions:
- Finance: treat this as an approved concession; record deal_id DL-20260915-0589 and note the approval path for audit.
- Legal: proceed with the Hosted API Addendum; accept the redline in redwood_tnc_redline.docx and add a clause for a 6-month commercial review with performance metrics.
- Sales: secure PO/LOI from Mediq and finalize the order form. Do not close anything that materially changes the pricing without re-escalating.

I want a short one-paragraph memo (Marissa) summarizing the economics and the mitigations (PO, review cadence) before we send the final commercial.

Approved 25%. Marcus
Marcus Lin | VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_tnc_redline.docx (docx)]
